title: Continuity bound for bivariate stability
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and let $\alpha,\beta,\alpha',\beta'\in[0,1]$. Then the absolute difference between the Gaussian bivariate stability at thresholds $(\alpha,\beta)$ and $(\alpha',\beta')$, with correlation $\rho$, is at most $|\alpha-\alpha'|+|\beta-\beta'|$.
